title: console public web form: a refused submit marks no field, and the page carries no app branding (blue button beside an orange app, monospace placeholder)
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C

This card holds rows 9 and 10 of #27355, HotCRM's browser pass on 18.2.0 (hotcrm#2320). They are carded here under triage's per-row rule. Seat `domain:ui#5` filed it. Seats 1 and 2 confirmed no collision at 2026-10-29T05:56Z.

## Observed (18.2.0)

| Row | Observed | Report |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | A refused submit on a public web form (`/forms/:name`) shows a toast and a banner but does not mark the fields. | [Sales](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443461344) S6 |
| 9 | A public form carries no branding. Its submit button is blue while the app's colour is orange, and the description placeholder is monospace. | Sales S6, [Service](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6444034183) S3 |

## Read on `origin/main` `45c9be5f` (code only)

- **The page.** The page is console `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` (3,132 lines). `App.tsx` routes the app-less `/forms/:name` to it, and `AppContent.tsx` routes the in-app `forms/:name` to it. It hand-renders its fields and does not use plugin-form's `ObjectForm`.
- **Row 10.** Every refusal path writes one string to `setError` and `toast.error`: the client required check (≈L2486–2498), the faulted `visibleWhen` (≈L2475–2483) and the server catch (≈L2670–2675). No path puts a mark on a field.
  - The record dialog already marks refused fields. For example, #26891 marks the field a `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` names, and server validation errors carry field paths.
  - The fix marks each refused field (`aria-invalid` plus its message under the control) from what the refusal already names. It reuses the record dialog's reader of the server's field paths rather than writing a second one.
- **Row 9.** To be measured. On the in-app route the page sits inside an app, so the theme should already apply. If it doesn't, that's the bug. On the app-less route the page may not know its app at all. Find out whether the served form definition names its app (or its object's app) and whether its `branding.primaryColor` / `logo` can be read without auth.
  - If they can, apply them as the app shell does.
  - If they cannot, the app-less half needs a server or spec door. Then deliver the in-app half and the placeholder font only, and record the rest as an open question.
  - The monospace placeholder is likely a `font-mono` class on the description/textarea control. Use the body font.

## Out of bounds

ui seat 2's PR #27305 (#27159) rewrites plugin-form `ObjectForm.tsx` and `index.tsx`, adds `ObjectFormContainer.tsx`, deletes `SplitForm.tsx`, and touches `DrawerForm` / `ModalForm`, `ui/packages/types` form types and `component.zod.ts`. This card stays in the console public-form page. A change to any of those files lands after #27305.

## Done looks like

- A refused submit marks each refused field it names: client required, faulted `visibleWhen`, and server field-level refusals. The banner and toast stay as they are.
- The placeholder uses the body font.
- The form takes the app's brand colour (and logo) where the page can know the app. Where it can't, that is stated.
